decision.summaryForCoordinator: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Nineteen attacks run, nineteen refuted. The subject is a genuine remeasurement of frozen v2 onto live HEAD bf29297 / file 08 f909ddff / required-now 28, with the 26→28 delta exactly accounted for by D-167 and D-169. Both self-declared repairs — predecessor self-version sentences and D-167 recording placeholders — landed with no residual text. Two prose redundancies carried byte-identically from the ACCEPTed v2 are logged as observations, not findings: both assert true, mutually consistent propositions.
